reuse.why: Builds the rule into the existing shared getScheduledAmount, reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, and routes the API, budget template, forecast, schedule actions, posting, preview and client views through it.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline midpoint copies; range and approximate cases are each written once in getPlannedAmount's helpers.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, used by both server and client; the API field is computed in the API layer from the same helper.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its callers, the API field and type, tests and a release note (plus updating an outdated comment in Balance.tsx).

maintainability.why: One helper with an explicit operator parameter is easy to own and the 'least money in' rationale is documented; inserting op before the positional inverse flag is fragile, and useScheduleEdit's form conversion silently inherits the planning rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every place that resolved a schedule amount now calls getScheduledAmount.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts gains the op parameter (the real variation) and, through getPlannedAmount, an isapprox branch; no caller bypasses it.
